metadata.description: The codex plugin: delegate work from Claude Code to the OpenAI Codex CLI or OpenCode, with a live dashboard for the jobs.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Delegate coding tasks and reviews to the OpenAI Codex CLI, or tasks to OpenCode, and get the results back. Jobs survive restarts, and the AI Live Viewer dashboard shows Codex, Claude and OpenCode sessions and resumes and cancels jobs.
